headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential risks early in the installation process, improve user experience by providing immediate feedback on package integrity, and expand support for additional package managers like pip.
actions: Implement a real-time dependency analysis feature that scans for known vulnerabilities or malicious packages before installation.
Enhance the current npm/PyPI support to include other popular package managers such as pip, ensuring broader compatibility and coverage.
Develop an interactive dashboard within ClearInstall to provide users with detailed insights into the dependencies of their projects, including binding.gyp comm
